Outdoor jogging sequence: jogging through cloudy futuristic urban streets during early morning, dynamic running shots, drone angles, wind moving through hair, cinematic city atmosphere, motivational fitness energy.

Recovery scene: relaxing at home post workout while calmly drinking a shake in warm ambient evening lighting, cozy luxury apartment atmosphere, emotional cinematic pacing.

Ultra realistic commercial cinematography, glossy highlights, cinematic depth of field, smooth camera motion, luxury sportswear branding aesthetic, motivational fitness energy, realistic skin textures, premium advertisement quality, 8k realism, no text overlays, no watermark.
